__doc: SCHOOL ACTIVITIES ADDED FROM PHOTOGRAPHS THE SCHOOL SENT, NOT FROM THE SITE.
Every other activity was migrated out of data/schoolActivities.ts, which is
seed input and describes what the site already published. These two have no
entry there: they came from a folder of photographs, so they are written here
instead - reviewable, in git, and seeded by the same idempotent upsert as
everything else, so a rebuilt database produces them again.
WARNING: THE BODY SAYS ONLY WHAT THE PHOTOGRAPHS SHOW.
This site's whole editorial line is that it claims nothing the school has not
evidenced - three academics pages say outright that the school publishes
nothing on their subject rather than pad. A photograph beside a sentence IS
part of the claim, so the copy below describes what is visible in the frames
and names what is not known, and nothing else.
The dates come from the EXIF of the ORIGINAL files, recorded before the
client's re-export stripped it. They are not recoverable from what is on disk
now, which is why they are written down here.

activities.title: Art Integrated Learning
activities.body: Classes presenting their Art Integrated Learning work — tables of models, packaged regional food and folded textiles prepared by students, and presentations from the stage to the rest of the school. The school did not publish which classes took part or the topic each display covered.

activities.title: Sustainable Development Goals Session
activities.body: A session on the Sustainable Development Goals, held twice over: once for the whole school seated under the covered assembly area, and once for teaching and administrative staff in the conference room, with the goals set out on the board behind — no poverty, zero hunger, clean water and sanitation, climate action, life below water. The school did not publish who led the session or what it covered.
activities.alt: The Sustainable Development Goals session at {schoolName}

activities.title: India AI Tinkerpreneur and Math Around Me certificates
activities.body: Two sets of certificates presented on one morning. Eight students received India AI Tinkerpreneur 2025 certificates, which carry the marks of the Atal Innovation Mission and Intel; others received Certificates of Noteworthy Performance in Math Around Me, awarded by Mehro World School. The school did not publish the students’ names or what either programme required of them.

activities.title: Atal Tinkering Lab projects
activities.body: Students presenting projects built in the school’s Atal Tinkering Lab, the room signed as a Centre of Excellence and marked out for AR and VR, programming, drone and space technology. One group demonstrates a clap switch wired on a breadboard; others work at the benches behind. The school did not publish the brief the projects answered or the classes taking part.

activities.title: Book Fair
activities.body: The school’s book fair, opened by a ribbon cutting with staff, guests and two children of the junior school. The school did not publish which sellers took part or what the fair raised.

activities.title: Creepy Crawly — a KG activity
activities.body: A kindergarten activity on small creatures: children printing a caterpillar with leaves dipped in paint, seated on the mat with their teacher. The photographs the school sent are small phone images rather than camera frames.
activities.alt: A kindergarten Creepy Crawly activity at {schoolName}

activities.title: Archery on the JOSH ground
activities.body: Archery introduced on the JOSH ground, a target boss set up against the ground’s wall with classes gathered round it in winter uniform. The school did not publish whether the sport continued as a coached activity.
activities.alt: Archery on the JOSH ground at {schoolName}

activities.title: NDRF disaster-response session
activities.body: A National Disaster Response Force session at the school, held twice over: the whole school seated under the covered assembly area, and the support staff — drivers, gardeners and guards — gathered on the steps for a fire-extinguisher demonstration by a responder in NDRF coveralls. The school did not publish who led the session or what else it covered.

activities.title: Parent Orientation Programme
activities.body: A sitting of the Parent Orientation Programme — parents seated in the conference room, a slide put up on the screen and a member of the school speaking to it. The school did not publish the programme for the session or which classes it was for.
activities.alt: A Parent Orientation Programme sitting at {schoolName}

activities.title: Students’ Forum
activities.body: A sitting of the Students’ Forum, held around a table in the library. The school did not publish the forum’s agenda, its membership or how often it sits.

activities.title: Financial Literacy Club
activities.body: The school’s Financial Literacy Club, its table carrying a student-built model of the sectors of the Indian economy — primary, secondary and tertiary — with the senior classes seated behind. The school did not publish the club’s programme or who it is open to.

activities.title: Skating in the junior playground
activities.body: Junior classes skating on the paved playground in helmets and pads, in front of the school entrance. The school did not publish whether the sessions are coached or how often they run.

activities.title: Karate on the school ground
activities.body: A karate bout on the school ground — two students in gi with red and blue mitts and foot guards, one at the top of a high kick. The school did not publish whether these frames come from a graded bout or a practice session.

activities.title: Seasonal fruits and vegetables — a KG activity
activities.body: A kindergarten activity on seasonal produce, its hand-painted board set up outdoors and children hanging labelled fruit on a stem. The school did not publish what the activity covered beyond what the photographs show.
activities.alt: A kindergarten seasonal fruits and vegetables activity at {schoolName}

activities.title: Hindustan Pratibha Samman 2025
activities.body: A student of the school receiving a certificate at Hindustan Pratibha Samman 2025, an award ceremony for meritorious students presented by United University, Prayagraj. The school did not publish the student’s name or the marks the award recognised.
activities.alt: A student of {schoolName} at Hindustan Pratibha Samman 2025

activities.title: The girls’ hockey team, before the CBSE Cluster
activities.body: The girls’ hockey team garlanded and handed their kit at the school before the CBSE Cluster championship, a Sunbeam flag beside them. The school did not publish how the team went on to place, and none is claimed here.
activities.alt: The girls’ hockey team at {schoolName} before the CBSE Cluster championship

activities.title: INSPIRE Award — the district exhibition
activities.body: Students at the district-level exhibition and project competition of the INSPIRE Award, run by the Department of Science and Technology and the National Innovation Foundation, held at Government Girls Inter College, Azamgarh. The school did not publish the projects entered or how they were judged.
activities.alt: Students of {schoolName} at the district INSPIRE Award exhibition

activities.title: Interclass Attire Speak
activities.body: The interclass round of the Attire Speak competition, in which junior classes each wore a hand-drawn logo and spoke about the brand behind it — Google Classroom, Quizizz and others — with the same mark up on the board behind them. The school did not publish the classes entered or the result.
activities.alt: A junior student of {schoolName} at the Interclass Attire Speak competition
